beats.summary: Dwight insists on leaving to meet Angela despite Pam's pleas to stay with Cece.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: Well something's come up, I have to go.
Pam: Look, I know what you have to do, please stay with Cece.

beats.summary: Jim offers Dwight pizza and beer to help him think over the situation.

evidence.snippet:
Jim: What kind of pizza would you like?
Dwight: Surprise me. No! Pepperoni.

beats.summary: Dwight refuses to help Pam and Jim because of his obligation to Angela.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: I have a legal obligation to Angela. Okay, she needs to be serviced.
Pam: Okay fine! There must be some way to get out of it. Even just for tonight!

beats.summary: Andy becomes sick and vomits due to his feelings about Erin and Gabe.

evidence.snippet: Andy (throws up on bed): Puts pillow in front of the puke.

beats.summary: Michael attempts to fix the cable outage during the viewing party.

evidence.snippet: Michael (outside opening Gabe's cable hookup box): Okay… Alright.

beats.summary: Pam negotiates with Angela to postpone her meeting with Dwight until tomorrow night.

evidence.snippet: Pam: I know you and Dwight have this weird deal, uhm, he sent me out here to see if you could postpone.
Angela: Ok, uhm, then tell him that we'll do this tomorrow night instead.
